changes.detail: Open pairing and remote screen inside Android app, avoiding session loss caused by switching from browser to app.
Other-phone approval instructions, same-address navigation restriction, connection failure state and explicit/background/back disconnect handling. Browser fallback for web.

summary: Replaced the Android external-browser handoff with an embedded viewer and explicit instructions to approve on the other phone.
